The '''Lucites''' was an [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] cult formed out of the [[Skyholme Astromancers]], a group of [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitives]] that lived among the people of [[Weik/Legends|Weik]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] deep in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] that was long disconnected from the [[The galaxy/Legends|civilized galaxy]].

==History==
A group of antisocial [[Witch/Legends|wizards]] that formed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Weik/Legends|Weik]], the Lucites were [[Skyholme Astromancers]] that worshiped suffering and terror. Fiercely territorial, Lucites lived as hermits in small villas or towers where they presided over their arcane texts and studies. They believed that "the truth" had been unlocked when a star fell from the sky, teaching them that power came from the suffering of others. Hunted by the Astromancers for their cruel and vicious rituals the Lucites preformed on other living beings, some Lucites masqueraded among the Astromancers so that they could attend the annual conclave at [[Skyholme/Legends|Skyholme]].<ref name="NoP" />
